blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas at Fiba Asian Qualifiers Window 5 MANILA, Philippines–The height advantage that Gilas Pilipinas bolstered for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers allowed Kevin Quiambao to go on a scoring spree from the perimeter. Quiambao fired six three-pointers on his way to 18 points on Friday as Gilas rolled past Syria, 97-58, at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia to set a team record for most in a World Cup Qualifiers game. And with Bennie Boatwright, Kai Sotto, AJ Edu, Mike Phillips and Quentin Millora-Brown all providing a high ceiling, Quiambao has somehow been given […]...
